Welcome to Barfield Prep School
Raising the Barfield
At Barfield Prep School, we don’t just raise expectations – we Raise the Barfield. It’s our way of nurturing happy, well-rounded, high-achieving children who thrive in every sense.
At Barfield Prep School, we raise expectations and confidence. With small classes, inspiring teaching, and a love of learning indoors and out, every child thrives.
A school journey full of happiness, high expectations but always centered around the children’s happiness.
How do we “Raise the Barfield?”
Because education is more than just about exam results. Our commitment to a broad curriculum is second to none and ensures that we are able to stretch and support all our children academically, while never compromising on their happiness and well-being by offering learning in Life Skills, Well-being, Sustainability, the Arts and more. With small class sizes, tailored teaching and incredible staff, bright minds shine.
As we know that life is likely to have a road bump or two along the way, supporting the children to believe in themselves is a real focus of ours. Not only belief in themselves, but to build strong, purposeful relationships with those around them – friends, family, teachers and the wider community – always looking to promote positive values and characteristics throughout and finding belief in their personal journey – wherever that might take them!
Our children spend glorious amounts of time outdoors, allowing them to be children! Wellies, trainers, ballet shoes or football boots, a Barfield Child will likely be found ‘doing’, benefitting from any one of the amazing opportunities that are afforded to them on a daily basis. It is likely to be these moments that the children will remember when they reflect on their time at Barfield Prep School.

pageCache.pageTitle: Lower School Performing Arts - Barfield Prep School - Surrey
pageCache.text:
Performing Arts at Barfield
Dance & Drama
Through dance and drama, pupils develop technical skills, unleash their imaginations, and discover their unique voices in an inclusive and supportive environment. There are lots of performances throughout the year for all of our pupils. In the Lower school students have lessons in performing arts and music taught by specialist teachers honing their skills ahead of their performances in the Nativity and the Christmas Carol Services working towards the Lower School Performing Arts Summer Showcase which includes every child in the Lower School.
Ballet & Musical Theatre Club
For students taking Ballet classes there is also the Summer Ballet Showcase. The Lower School has no shortage of clubs include Lower School Drama Club and Musical Theatre Club. In the Upper School students continue Music and Drama lessons, continuing to build on their skills from Lower School. Year 3 and 4 have a production in the Spring Term and Year 5 and 6 students involved in the Drama Club have their performance at the end of the school year. Upper School benefit from Year 3 & 4 Drama Club, Senior Drama Club and Dance Troupe.
Music
Music is taught from Nursery by specialist teachers. Students are fortunate to be taught whole class instruments as part of their music lessons. We are fortunate to have an incredible team of peripatetic teachers who teach a host of different instruments for students wanting to have individual instrumental tuition.
We begin our performing year in the Autumn Term with all groups in the school taking part in our whole school Harvest and Remembrance Assemblies.
The Lower School goes on to work on their Nativity and Christmas Carol Service performances. Year 5 and 6 students have a Performing Arts Concert and an evening of Carols showcasing the Senior and Chamber Choirs as well as working towards the whole school Christmas Carol Service. In the Spring term Year 5’s and 6’s having Carol Services and the Summer term culminates with the Year 3’s and 4’s concert.
Our Performing Arts programme fosters essential life skills, including teamwork, discipline, and resilience, equipping our pupils for success in all aspects of life.
At Barfield, we celebrate the power of the arts to unite, inspire, and transform, nurturing a love of creativity that lasts a lifetime. Whether on stage or behind the scenes, every student is encouraged to dream big, aim high, and express themselves boldly. Join us at Barfield School, where the Performing Arts are truly coming alive!
Come and visit us!
Barfield is a warm, caring, family-orientated school, where happy and supported children go on to achieve great things.

pageCache.pageTitle: Extra-Curricular Activities at Barfield Prep School - Surrey
pageCache.text:
Extra Curricular
Something For Everyone
Club Highlights
Eco Club
LAMDA
Judo
Barfield School Eco Club is passionate about looking after our planet and want to make our school a greener, more environmentally aware, place to study and work.
The club considers the main issues currently affecting the planet and encourages the members to think about how they can play their part in making Barfield more sustainable.
The club members will work towards gaining eco-school status. This is pupil led and members will decide how to achieve this award. The club will also continue the work in the school orchard and garden and to improve the biodiversity of the area.
The club is open to all pupils who are passionate about our environment and want to make a difference.
LAMDA Speech and Drama lessons are available to all children in Years 1-6.
These classes happen throughout the school day and are timetabled on a weekly rotation. LAMDA aims to develop self-confidence and enhance the pupils’ drama knowledge and experience through fun exercises, communication and performance. Pupils will learn about vocal techniques, mime/movement and the theatre, as well as having the opportunity to express and develop their own creative ideas through performance. LAMDA examinations and a LAMDA Showcase are held annually.
Judo, a modern Olympic sport invented by a Japanese teacher, is a popular, general fitness training method and is also a fun sport.
Barfield has a long tradition of having an exciting and enthusiastic Judo activity. Tuition is provided by Mr Fricker, a judo black-belt and professional teacher from Judo School who represents ProCoach Judo. He has a strong reputation for motivating pupils to learn about judo in an exciting way, encouraging enjoyment from the sport.
Ballet
Golf
Survival Skills
Barfield Ballet is held on a Wednesday throughout the year for children in Owlets to Year 6 and is taught by a Royal Academy of Dance (RAD) Registered Teacher.
Ballet is a great way to stay active, creative and learn the technique and discipline of ballet. Children are taught dances, exercises and routines from the Royal Academy of Dance Syllabi at an appropriate level for their age. Older students have the opportunity to create their own choreography. Parents are invited to a Showcase in the Summer Term.
Peter & Ollie from Farnham Golf Club offer a fun and friendly Golf Club to children from Year 1 – 6.
From team matches, individual games, penalty shoot-outs, short chips and pressure putts, children have lots of fun whilst learning the basics of golf – plus they get to do all of this with their school friends! This club takes place in the Barfield sports hall during the Autumn and Spring Terms. Summer Term courses are held at Farnham Gold Club (free transport is provided).
Survival Skills is designed to look at the topics of survival with the children in our school setting.
Topics covered may include building shelters, navigation, communication, first aid, and bushcraft skills with lots of games and fun activities too.
Come and visit us!

Barfield Three Peaks – Adventure Birthday Parties
Make your child’s birthday one to remember with an exciting, adventure-filled party at Barfield Three Peaks! Our unique birthday party experience is packed with thrilling outdoor activities, exclusive use of our facilities, and a fun environment that will have all their friends talking long after the party ends.
What’s included in Our Birthday Parties
• Exclusive Access: Enjoy private use of our site and facilities. • Qualified Staff: Our experienced, friendly team provides supervision, guidance, and a full safety briefing to ensure everyone has a safe and memorable experience. • All Safety Equipment: Safety is our priority. We provide all necessary equipment and a detailed briefing for a worry-free adventure. • Certificates for All: Every participant leaves with a special certificate as a memento of their adventure. • Party Area: After the activities, enjoy using our Party Area or School Hall for up to 30 minutes for a birthday tea celebration. • Printable Invitations: We provide printable invitations to make planning your event a breeze.
Party Packages:
PLATINUM PACKAGE – from £20pp
-2 hours of non-stop adventure, max 16 participants
For those Laser Tag Commandos!! – 2 hours of Combat Laser Tag: includes Laser Tag target shooting practice and Laser Tag Games (King of the Hill, Domination, Capture the Flag, and Tug of War). Click here for activity details.
GOLD PACKAGE – from £18.50pp
-2 hours max 16 participants
For those budding Quad Biker’s! – Quad Biking for 1 hour plus choose one from either Archery, Low Ropes, Command Tasks, Frisbee Golf, Aeroball or Orienteering for the second hour. Click here for activity details.
**Please note that all children must complete the Quad Driving test before riding solo, and during the winter months our tracks can become flooded, so we will always aim to go ahead with quad biking, but may need to change the activity if the tracks are not useable.
-2 hours max 16 participants
For those Laser Tag Commandoes! Laser Combat for 1 hour plus choose one from either Archery, Low Ropes, Command Tasks, Frisbee Golf, Aeroball or Orienteering for the second hour. Click here for activity details.
SILVER PACKAGE – from £17pp
-2 hours max 16 participants
For those with a head for heights!!!
Choose one High Activity – Leap of Faith, Crate Challenge, Gladiator Challenge or Climbing wall plus choose one from either: Archery, Low Ropes, Command Tasks, Frisbee Golf, Aeroball or Orienteering. Click here for activity details.
BRONZE PACKAGE – from £15pp
-2 hours max 16 participants
For those with lots of energy to burn!!!
Choose 3 Activities from Archery, Low Ropes, Command Tasks, Frisbee Golf, Aeroball, Orienteering. Click here for activity details.
Activities & Party Details
Our birthday party package includes 2 hours of outdoor activities led by our fully qualified staff, ensuring a fun and active experience for your group. • Group Size: Parties are designed for groups of up to 16 participants. • Arrival: Please arrive 15 minutes prior to the start of your party. • Fixed Price: Our parties are offered at a fixed price, ensuring excellent value for a fully hosted, adventure-filled experience.
Time Slots
• Winter (1st November – 28th February): Saturdays & Sundays, 10:00 am – 12:00 noon & 1:00 pm – 3:00 pm • Summer (1st March – 31st October): Saturdays & Sundays, 9:00 am – 11:00 am, 12:00 noon – 2:00 pm & 3:00 pm – 5:00 pm

pageCache.pageTitle: History of Barfield - Barfield Prep School - Surrey
pageCache.text:
History of Barfield
Barfield Prep School: A Legacy of Excellence. Since its founding in 1933, Barfield Prep School has inspired young minds and fostered a love of learning.
Nestled in a 12-acre woodland of Farnham, Barfield Prep School was originally a small boys’ Boarding School dedicated to providing a nurturing and holistic education. Over the years, we have grown into one of the most respected preparatory schools, blending tradition with innovation.
The story of Barfield Prep School began with a vision: to create a community where children could thrive academically, socially, and emotionally. The founders believed in cultivating curiosity, resilience, and a strong moral compass in every child. This ethos remains at the heart of Barfield today, shaping generations of students who positively impact the world.
Over the decades, Barfield has evolved to meet the changing needs of education. Early on, the school established a reputation for academic excellence, underpinned by a robust pastoral care system. Today, Barfield combines a rigorous curriculum with a rich co-curricular program that includes arts, sports, and outdoor learning opportunities. This balanced approach ensures that every child can discover and develop their unique talents.

pageCache.text:
Nursery: Welcome
At Barfield, we believe in creating a nurturing, safe, and stimulating environment where young minds can grow and thrive.
Our mission is to provide exceptional care and early education for children, stimulating their curiosity, creativity, and social development through play-based learning.
The Nursery provides a gentle introduction to school life and we welcome children as soon as they turn two. The Hatchlings (2 year olds), Owlets (2-3 year olds) and Owls (3-4 year olds) are very much a part of the school, making full use of Barfield’s extensive grounds with access to a wide range of outdoor learning experiences.
Children enjoy a refreshingly varied curriculum from an early age and are taught by specialist teachers for PE, Swimming, Music, French and Outdoor Learning. They are integrated into the main school in a careful and considered way, gradually getting to know more members of the school staff as they move through the school.
They use the dining hall to eat hot lunches every day and take part in whole school events such as whole school assemblies, Easter bonnet parade, Sports Day and shared reading, where the older children come down into the Nursery to read to the children. Our Nursery is very much part of our school.
Our Nursery is divided into three age groups:
Hatchlings
Owlets
Owls
What We Offer
Tailored programs for children aged, focusing on cognitive, emotional, and physical development.
Our dedicated, experienced, and caring educators are passionate about nurturing every child’s potential.
We recognise that every child is unique, and we offer personalized care and attention to suit their individual needs.
Play-Based Activities:
Play-based learning places the child at the center of their own learning process. Children have the freedom to choose activities and explore topics that interest them.
Many play-based activities promote group work, communication, and collaboration, helping children to develop social and emotional skills.
Play-based learning encourages children to think creatively, solve problems, and use their imaginations to make sense of the world around them.
Subject Specialist Teaching:
All children in the Nursery have Music taught to them by a specialist teacher. As the children move through the Nursery we introduce new subjects and teachers to enrich their curriculum, PE, Swimming, Outdoor Learning and finally French.
Our Facilities
Bright, Spacious Classrooms: Fully equipped with safe, stimulating toys, learning materials, and age-appropriate resources.
Heated Indoor Swimming Pool where children enjoy fortnightly lessons in Owlets and weekly lessons in Owls.
Purpose built playgrounds
12 acre site to explore – including forests, orchard and pond
Outdoor Play Area
All of our classrooms have access to a well-maintained outdoor space where children can run, play, and explore nature. The children also make use of our ‘Sandy play’ area which is designed to excite and development children’s creative and physical development with a mixture of climbing, balance and adventure equipment.
Our Nursery is a very valued and included part of our Barfield family. The children eat lunch in the Dinning Hall. They have lunch break in Sandy Play at the same time as the rest of the School, meaning that siblings can meet or wave at each other from across the field whilst playing with their friends and they attend whole school assemblies.

Barfield is a warm, caring, family-orientated school, where happy and supported children go on to achieve great things.

pageCache.pageTitle: Our Independent Nursery at Barfield Prep School - Surrey
pageCache.text:
Nursery: Welcome
At Barfield, we believe in creating a nurturing, safe, and stimulating environment where young minds can grow and thrive.
Our mission is to provide exceptional care and early education for children, stimulating their curiosity, creativity, and social development through play-based learning.
The Nursery provides a gentle introduction to school life and we welcome children as soon as they turn two. The Hatchlings (2 year olds), Owlets (2-3 year olds) and Owls (3-4 year olds) are very much a part of the school, making full use of Barfield’s extensive grounds with access to a wide range of outdoor learning experiences.
Children enjoy a refreshingly varied curriculum from an early age and are taught by specialist teachers for PE, Swimming, Music, French and Outdoor Learning. They are integrated into the main school in a careful and considered way, gradually getting to know more members of the school staff as they move through the school.
They use the dining hall to eat hot lunches every day and take part in whole school events such as whole school assemblies, Easter bonnet parade, Sports Day and shared reading, where the older children come down into the Nursery to read to the children. Our Nursery is very much part of our school.
Our Nursery is divided into three age groups:
Hatchlings
Owlets
Owls
What We Offer
Tailored programs for children aged, focusing on cognitive, emotional, and physical development.
Our dedicated, experienced, and caring educators are passionate about nurturing every child’s potential.
We recognise that every child is unique, and we offer personalized care and attention to suit their individual needs.
Play-Based Activities:
Play-based learning places the child at the center of their own learning process. Children have the freedom to choose activities and explore topics that interest them.
Many play-based activities promote group work, communication, and collaboration, helping children to develop social and emotional skills.
Play-based learning encourages children to think creatively, solve problems, and use their imaginations to make sense of the world around them.
Subject Specialist Teaching:
All children in the Nursery have Music taught to them by a specialist teacher. As the children move through the Nursery we introduce new subjects and teachers to enrich their curriculum, PE, Swimming, Outdoor Learning and finally French.
Our Facilities
Bright, Spacious Classrooms: Fully equipped with safe, stimulating toys, learning materials, and age-appropriate resources.
Heated Indoor Swimming Pool where children enjoy fortnightly lessons in Owlets and weekly lessons in Owls.
Purpose built playgrounds
12 acre site to explore – including forests, orchard and pond
Outdoor Play Area
All of our classrooms have access to a well-maintained outdoor space where children can run, play, and explore nature. The children also make use of our ‘Sandy play’ area which is designed to excite and development children’s creative and physical development with a mixture of climbing, balance and adventure equipment.
Our Nursery is a very valued and included part of our Barfield family. The children eat lunch in the Dinning Hall. They have lunch break in Sandy Play at the same time as the rest of the School, meaning that siblings can meet or wave at each other from across the field whilst playing with their friends and they attend whole school assemblies.
Come and Visit Us
Barfield is a warm, caring, family-orientated school, where happy and supported children go on to achieve great things.

Wellbeing
We promote positive mental and physical health so that our children leave us as confident and happy individuals with a wellbeing toolkit ready to take on their next challenges.
We have embedded an ethos where mental health and emotional wellbeing is regarded as the responsibility of all teachers to monitor, but also for all pupils to be aware of.
Throughout their time at Barfield they should be building their knowledge on self-regulation, self-awareness and coping strategies for their thoughts and feelings.
Barfield children develop the understanding of what contributes to a healthy mind and body and it enables them to have the emotional literacy to express themselves, not only when things go right, but also when they go wrong. We provide a platform that gives our children a voice; a voice that allows them to be able to express their feelings and know that these feelings will be listened to and acknowledged.
In the nursery the children focus on the Zones of Regulation to help their understanding of feelings and emotions.
The children are supported with their emotional wellbeing in the classroom, through various topic books and stories, including ‘Find your happy’ and ‘The Colour Monster’. The children build strong relationships with the nursery team, who are always available when needed, for both the child and their family.

pageCache.text:
Wrap Around Care
Our After-School and Breakfast Clubs are designed to provide a safe and nurturing environment before and after school.
School Breakfast Club
If you need an early start to your day our School Breakfast Club is a welcoming programme designed to provide students with a nutritious start to their school day. It offers a safe and supportive environment where children can enjoy a balanced breakfast, socialise with peers, and prepare for their day ahead. Doors open at 7.30am and all children from Owls upwards are welcome to attend.
Great Lates
We understand that working parents need reliable and flexible care, and our Great Lates programme ensures that your children are well looked after while continuing to engage in exciting activities. This runs from the end of the school day till 6.15pm where children are given a cold tea and then have the time to complete tasks in a calm and focused environment. This balance of relaxation and learning helps them wind down after the school day, ensuring they’re ready to go home with a sense of accomplishment and well-being.

pageCache.pageTitle: Digital Learning - Barfield Prep School - Surrey
pageCache.text:
Digital Learning
It’s our mission to ensure that the children learn skills needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving world. Our Digital Learning Suite combines state-of-the-art technology with a dynamic, forward-thinking curriculum.
Cutting Edge Tools
Our Digital Learning Suite offers interactive spaces equipped with high-tech resources, fostering an environment where students can explore, experiment and excel.
Guided by dedicated teachers who are experts in their fields, pupils not only learn to navigate a variety of digital platforms but also develop a deep understanding of how to harness technology responsibly and ethically. All children at Barfield Prep School learn about the risks and how to stay safe while online, a message that is woven into the learning at every opportunity.
From Year 3 Barfield Prep School’s children carry Chromebooks as part of their pencil case. Every Chromebook brought into school is managed by our specialist IT team. This approach ensures every child is equipped with skills like touch typing along with the confidence to become a leader in an increasingly digital world. Our most inspired pupils in Year 6 become Ambassadors for Digital Learning and they willingly and confidently share their knowledge and skills with our younger children, At Barfield, digital learning isn’t just about technology; it’s about unlocking potential, sparking imagination, and building a brighter tomorrow.
Come and visit us!

pageCache.pageTitle: Upper School Academics at Barfield Prep School - Surrey
pageCache.text:
Upper School Academics
The Upper School comprises of Years 3 – 6.
The curriculum has a contemporary, hands-on feel where children debate and explore subjects. We are committed to developing life-long learners with enquiring minds. Teamwork and collaboration are high on the agenda in our teaching practice, providing both the skills and knowledge that will equip pupils well for the ever changing future.
Preparing Pupils for 11+
Subjects
Maths
English
Science
Geography
At Barfield, we infuse energy and excitement into every aspect of our mathematical learning environment, sparking curiosity and igniting a passion for discovery.
Mathematics comes alive here, empowering pupils to engage with the world through essential skills like calculation, problem-solving, and reasoning. Our dynamic, balanced, and forward-thinking curriculum lays a solid foundation of knowledge, equipping pupils to approach challenges with confidence and capability. With a wealth of resources and exceptional facilities, we create engaging opportunities that make learning impactful and enjoyable. From hands-on activities to real-world applications, pupils explore mathematical concepts in creative and meaningful ways, building their understanding step by step. Communication and collaboration are at the heart of our approach, ensuring every pupil feels supported in their learning journey. High aspirations underpin everything we do in Mathematics. We foster a growth mindset, encouraging pupils to embrace challenges, persevere, and see setbacks as opportunities to learn and grow. At Barfield, Mathematics is more than numbers—it’s a gateway to understanding the complexities of the world and a tool for lifelong success. By nurturing resilience, curiosity, and determination, we aim to inspire confident learners ready to thrive in an ever-evolving world. Mathematics at Barfield truly unlocks potential and shapes futures.
With English being the first language in over 60 countries throughout the world, our English curriculum is designed to inspire and nurture articulate, creative, and confident communicators.
From the earliest years, pupils are immersed in a rich tapestry of language experiences that cultivate a love for literature, a mastery of communication, and an appreciation for the beauty of expression. Reading widely across genres, cultures, and eras, our students develop empathy and critical thinking while discovering the joy of storytelling. Writing is celebrated as both an art and a skill, with pupils crafting everything from imaginative tales and poetry to persuasive essays and reports. Rigorous teaching of grammar, punctuation, and vocabulary ensures clarity and precision, while innovative activities like drama, debates, and public speaking build confidence and eloquence. Technology is seamlessly integrated, equipping students with the tools to navigate and create in the digital age. Through engaging lessons, passionate teaching, and enriching experiences, pupils at Barfield learn to listen thoughtfully, write beautifully, and speak with confidence. Our English curriculum doesn’t just teach language—it shapes well-rounded individuals with experiences like English Speaking Board experiences, who demonstrate and articulate their ideas with grace, connect with others meaningfully, and thrive in a modern, interconnected world. By the time they leave Barfield, our students embody the transformative power of words.
At Barfield Prep School, the children get the opportunity to experience some of the wonders of Science when they come alive in an inspiring and dynamic environment that nurtures curiosity and ignites a passion for discovery.
Through hands-on experiments, interactive lessons that have real-world applications, the children are encouraged to think critically and explore the limitless potential of the scientific world. Our dedicated teaching staff at Barfield encourage an atmosphere where questioning, investigating, and problem-solving are celebrated, empowering pupils to take ownership of their learning journey and not be afraid to make decisions regardless of whether they are correct or not. Our Science Curriculum is broad! From the mysteries of the natural world to the marvels of technology and space exploration, Science at Barfield engages young minds with captivating approaches that go beyond the textbook. The school’s laboratory is highly equipped and suitable for stretching our children’s learning towards GCSE and beyond. Our Outdoor learning spaces provide the perfect setting for pupils to experiment, analyse and draw meaningful conclusions, deepening their understanding of key scientific concepts. Barfield’s child centred approach ensures that every child develops confidence in their ability to ask big questions and seek solutions, laying the foundation for lifelong learning. By weaving sustainability, Social Development Goals and global awareness into the Curriculum, pupils are also inspired to use Science as a tool to make a positive impact on the world. The children are particularly motivated by professional speakers who work in the Science disciplines, in the hope that our pupils will consider pursuing a career that can shape the future.
Students explore topics from physical landscapes to global challenges like climate change. With a focus on the UN Global Goals, they connect classroom learning to real-world issues such as sustainability and climate action.
Outdoor Learning enhances this by offering hands-on experiences, like studying ecosystems or local geography, fostering a deep appreciation for the environment and a sense of responsibility to protect it.
History
Humanities
Languages
Current Affairs
By examining key historical events, students learn how the past shapes the present and informs the future.
History builds critical thinking and empathy, helping students reflect on cultural diversity and learn from the mistakes of the past to make informed decisions for a better world.
Humanities equips students with critical thinking, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, preparing them to navigate modern complexities.
At our school, this comprehensive education nurtures informed, open-minded citizens who are ready to contribute to a sustainable and equitable future.
At Barfield School, the joy of learning French goes far beyond vocabulary and grammar, creating a truly enriching experience for every child.
Immersed in the language from an early age, students are introduced to French through dynamic, interactive lessons that spark curiosity and engagement. Songs, games, role-play, and storytelling bring the language to life, helping children build confidence as they practice speaking, listening, and expressing themselves creatively. The vibrant culture of French-speaking countries is seamlessly woven into the curriculum, introducing pupils to traditions, cuisine, and celebrations that inspire a genuine appreciation for diversity. This holistic approach fosters not only linguistic skills but also a deeper connection to the world around them. Whether it’s the thrill of mastering a new phrase or the laughter shared during a group activity, learning French at Barfield School is a joyful journey of discovery. These experiences ignite a lifelong love for languages, empowering students to communicate with confidence, embrace new perspectives, and thrive as global citizens. By making language learning both fun and meaningful, Barfield School ensures that each child finds joy in their studies and develops the skills to connect with a world of possibilities.
Pupils in Years 3 to 6 benefit from a dedicated weekly 30-minute Current Affairs lesson, during which time they explore important global, national and local events in an engaging and age-appropriate way.
This invaluable addition to the Curriculum not only keeps young minds informed, but it also enhances the children’s historical and cultural awareness, helping them to understand the world’s ever-evolving landscape. By discussing real-world issues, pupils develop critical thinking skills, listening and speaking skills, empathy and a broader perspective – all part of an essential foundation for their future education and personal growth.
Learning Support, Gifted & Talented
There is a thriving Learning Support Department for those who need an extra specialist help whilst a dedicated scholarship class in Maths and English are available throughout the Autumn term to ensure the very able pupils are given every chance to fulfil their academic ambitions. We also run an EPP (Eleven Plus Pathway programme) which aims to provide our Performing Arts scholars with additional tme to perfect their scholarship practice.
The curriculum is supported by an array of extra-curricular activities, regular sport, field trips, residential trips and outings to the theatre, museums, art galleries and places of cultural interest.
The pupils are divided into four Houses and there is fierce competition between them. They compete in Music, Sports Day and other events.

pageCache.pageTitle: Sports at Barfield Independent Prep | Barfield Prep School - Surrey
pageCache.text:
Upper School Sports
At Barfield Prep School, Physical Education (PE) and Games are pivotal to our holistic approach to education, delivering a multitude of benefits that transcend mere physical fitness. Our dynamic and inclusive programme empowers pupils to enhance not only their physical abilities but also their academic, social, and emotional skills, establishing a robust foundation for lifelong well-being.
A Range of Activities
Match Days
Swimming
At Barfield, we focus on the joy of participation with all pupils participating. Scoring a goal, achieving a personal best or mastering a new skill are all learning lessons.
These accomplishments are essential for building self-esteem, fostering a sense of achievement, and nurturing a positive mindset. We celebrate every pupil’s effort and progress, ensuring that children of all abilities feel included, valued, and motivated.
Our commitment to active play and outdoor learning allows children to enjoy fresh air and exercise, which boosts concentration, reduces stress, and enhances their readiness for academic pursuits. By emphasizing teamwork, respect, and sportsmanship, we reinforce the values that contribute to shaping well-rounded and empathetic individuals.
Ultimately, Physical Education and Games at Barfield Prep School equip pupils with the tools and mindset necessary for leading balanced, healthy lives. By instilling a lifelong enthusiasm for health and fitness, we empower our pupils to thrive in all aspects of their lives.
